product_line: Eaton Pow-R-Line panelboards (legacy 1a / 2a / 3a / 4 / 4B and current Pow-R-Line Xpert 1X / 2X / 3X / 3E / 4X)
license_note: Dimensional and rating FACTS only. No Eaton drawings, CAD/BIM files, catalog prose or images are stored. See ../LICENSE_NOTES.md.

collection_posture.summary: eaton.com pages and PDFs block scripted clients (timeouts to automated fetch, confirmed 2026-08-03). Facts were read from Eaton-authored documents (catalog CA08100003E Vol 2 Tab 3 June 2020; renewal parts RP01400001E April 2021) hosted by Eaton's authorized regional distributor site eatonarabia.com, and from the Eaton Arabia product technical page. Eaton's website terms default to personal/non-commercial download 'unless otherwise specified' (docs/product/content-strategy.md row 2); we copy nothing but factual figures (Feist basis), one manual-equivalent read per document, no bulk crawling.
collection_posture.method: single WebFetch per document + local text extraction of the returned PDF; figures transcribed by hand into this file

S1.doc: Eaton Volume 2 - Commercial Distribution, Tab 3 'Panelboards and Lighting Control', CA08100003E, June 2020 (pages V2-T3-2 .. V2-T3-134)
S1.note: Eaton catalog PDF hosted by authorized regional distributor; text extracted locally, tables read directly (Panelboard Selection Guide V2-T3-11; PRL1X/2X/3X/4X sizing pages).

S2.doc: Eaton Renewal Parts RP01400001E 'Pow-R-Line Xpert and legacy', effective April 2021
S2.note: States standard box widths shared by legacy and Xpert types, and the product-history timeline.

S3.doc: Eaton Arabia (authorized distributor) - Pow-R-Line 1a technical data page
S3.note: Legacy 1a technical table (voltage, bus current, IR, standards, enclosure types, box W/D/H options).

box_width_standard_in.note: Standard box width 20.00 in (508.0 mm) for PRL1X/2X/3X (100-600 A) AND legacy PRL1a/2a/3a (RP01400001E).

box_width_optional_in.note: Optional 28-inch (711.2 mm) wide box; required for PRL3X 800 A.

box_depth_standard_in.note: Standard box depth 5-3/4 in (146.1 mm) for the 20/28-in wide types.

box_heights_available_in.note: YS/EZB box heights 36/42/48/60/72/90 in (914.4/1066.8/1219.2/1524.0/1828.8/2286.0 mm). Height is chosen from mains rating + branch-circuit count (options.box_height_by_circuits).

gutter_top_bottom_min_in.note: Top and bottom gutters 5-1/2 in (139.7 mm) minimum (PRL1X/2X/3X sizing pages).

mounting.note: Specify surface or flush mounting; EZ/LT trims have S (surface) and F (flush) variants.

enclosure_nema_types.note: NEMA Type 1, 2, 3R, 4, 4X and 12 (1a technical page). NEMA classification PB-1; UL 67 / CSA.

pr4_box_widths_in.note: PRL4X and legacy PRL4/4B standard widths 24.00, 36.00, 44.00 in (609.6 / 914.4 / 1117.6 mm).

pr4_box_depth_in.note: PRL4X box catalog depth column 11.31 in (287.0 mm); note reads box depth 10.40 in (264.2 mm), cover adds 0.90 in (22.9 mm).

pr4_gutters_in.note: PRL4X: top/bottom 10.63 in (269.9 mm) min; side gutters 5.00 / 6.00 / 8.00 in for 24 / 36 / 44 in wide boxes.

weights.note: NOT SOURCED - the catalog sections read do not tabulate panelboard weights. Do not emit a weight parameter.

legacy_history.note: Product-history timeline; the user's 1a/2a/3a/4B spec maps to the current Xpert 1X/2X/3X/4X with the same standard box widths.
